content:
Best Buy has updated its 60th anniversary sale, and we're continuing to track the AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, AirPods Max 2 with $120 off, and AirTag 2 at its all-time low price. However, today's 9to5Tows midday picks also include: the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with a massive $500 off on Amazon, the brand-new Anker SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card dropping to $25 for an all-time low, and Mint Mobile launching an unprecedented 50% discount with unlimited talk and data plans for just $15 per month for a full year. Details below.

Best Buy updates 60th anniversary sale with TVs starting from $110, electronics up to half price, appliances with $1,000 off, and more deals

AirPods deals drop again, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, plus more

Following several solid deals on the latest AirPods lineup this summer, nearly the entire range is seeing price drops once again. The highly sought-after AirPods Pro 3 is now available at a 25% discount, offering one of its best prices ever, while the AirPods 4 with ANC has also dropped to its lowest price in months. The AirPods Max 2 was further reduced by $120 earlier this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)

Rare deal: M4 Mac mini gets $150 off today at Apple Certified Refurbished Store

Update: This deal has sold out, and we'll be keeping a close eye on restocks.

There have been plenty of great deals on models like the AirPods Pro 3, the new AirTag 2, and the M5 MacBook Pro, but deals on the latest M4 Mac mini have been extremely rare. Retailers like Amazon and Best Buy are nearly sold out, while deals have appeared consistently in the past. We've just spotted an extremely rare opportunity to grab a 16GB/512GB M4 Mac mini with $150 off at Apple's Certified Refurbished Store.

Apple's Certified Refurbished Store is currently selling the M4 Mac mini with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $849, with free shipping.

Price drops again: 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro sees a massive $500 discount on Amazon

This week brought notable deals with $400 off on select new M5 Pro MacBook Pro models as part of a special one-day Apple event. However, we want to highlight one specific configuration — this 2TB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is now $500 off on Amazon.

Amazon is currently selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and a 2TB internal SSD for $2,699, with free shipping.

This is a $3,199 configuration with the upgraded 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU (rather than the current $400-off model with a 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU). Although this model just had its price increased, the current price is still $100 lower than the previous lower MSRP.

Both options are good, depending on what performance you need — currently $400 and $500 off the official pricing respectively. Normally, upgrading the CPU/GPU costs an extra $200, but with the current deals, it only requires an additional $100:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (originally $2,999) — 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (originally $3,199) — 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

We expect this $500 discount won't last long, but we can't confirm whether it will hold until Sunday when this week's major promotional event ends.

The latest Apple AirTag 2 hits all-time low price on Amazon this week, now available for as low as $20 each

Apple deals keep coming this week, with the AirPods Pro 3 still at 25% off and the latest AirPods Max 2 with $120 off representing one of its largest discounts ever. In addition to $500 off select M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations, other standout deals are on the latest AirTag 2 tracker, with both single and 4-packs returning to all-time low prices — but now you can grab one for as low as $20.

Amazon has dropped AirTag 2 single and 4-pack pricing to the best prices we've tracked since its earlier launch this year:

  • AirTag 2 $24 (originally $29)
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (originally $99)

The 4-pack averages out to just $22.25 per tag, while the single AirTag 2 has returned to its all-time low price of $24 seen during Prime Day.

While the gap isn't huge, it's worth mentioning that the 'Premium' open-box condition single AirTag 2 at Best Buy is also at the lowest price we've tracked — available for just $19.99.

  • AirTag 2 'Premium' open-box $20 (originally $29 new) | Best Buy

Although this is only $4 lower than Amazon's new unit pricing, I personally would rather just get the new unit, which is indeed cheaper. Best Buy is also offering the same discount on new units, so if you're placing an order during its 60th anniversary sale, it's worth keeping an eye on those options.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary sale takes $100 off, Best Buy open-box deals starting from $254

Anker's brand-new SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card supports iOS or Android, drops to all-time low of $25 on Amazon

Anker recently launched its brand-new SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card — the first product to simultaneously support Apple's tracking platform and Google Find Hub — and it's now hitting a new low of $25 on Amazon, with free shipping for Prime members.

Anker's official EufyHome Amazon store is currently selling the new SmartTrack Card E40 for iOS or Android at $24.99, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

The product initially launched on Amazon last month priced at $35, saw a minor $5 discount by month-end, and is now receiving its first significant discount, setting a new Amazon low.

This works out to nearly a 30% discount, with pricing on par with some of the wallet tracker card deals we've tracked this year.

I'm personally a huge fan of Nomad Tracking Cards — the basic version starts from $35, while the Pro version with 16-month battery life is $45. But regardless of which you choose, I think everyone should put one in their wallet or cardholder. I never leave home without mine.

Anker's latest SmartTrack Card E40 comes with all the important features, including wireless charging, and works with either Apple Find My or Google Find Hub. It's only 1.7mm thick and has a ring volume of up to 80dB, making it easy to track when nearby. Of course, it can also be added directly to the Find My and Find Hub apps to view its location on a map.

Mint Mobile launches unprecedented 50% discount, unlimited talk and data 12-month plan for just $15/month

Mint Mobile is currently running an impressive unlimited 5G/4G LTE mobile plan promotion. While this carrier offers solid value most of the year, it's now offering its unlimited 12-month plan for just $15 per month — that's 50% off, with unlimited talk, text, and data for the entire year for only $180. Even if you're not looking to switch your primary plan right now, such a low price is worth considering as a backup or secondary line for an iPad.

While its 17GB and 23GB plans are also discounted, the best value here is the 5G • 4G LTE plan: unlimited / MO, just $15/month for 12 months.

  • Mint Mobile unlimited 12-month plan $15/month (50% off)

According to the fine print, you'll need to prepay $180 for the 12-month plan (equivalent to $15/month), but for users looking to switch to a new carrier at a discounted price, or add a secondary/backup line for another device, this is indeed a very good deal.

You can 'instantly activate service on eSIM-capable phones,' and the plan works with a variety of Apple, Samsung, and Google devices. If needed, you can keep your existing number and bring an unlocked phone to use the service.

Visit the deal page for more details.

The latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits a new low on Amazon, nearly 30% off (wired version also on sale)

As part of a late-summer sale on Fire tablets, Fire TVs, and Blink smart home products, Amazon is offering the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro at its all-time lowest price, and has brought the wired version's pricing back to its historic Prime Day low — both are nearly 30% off official pricing.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (originally $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (originally $250)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Anker MagSafe power bank available this week for as low as $36 (multiple colors available)
  • Anker 25W Qi2 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger performs excellently, now available at 35% off (hitting historic low)
  • The Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the most beautiful MagSafe stands I've seen, now available for $27 (originally $35)
  • Twelve South all-in-one braided PowerCord USB-C charger now as low as $16.50 (45% off)
  • Anker Nano 100W 3-port charger with included 5-foot cable, today as low as $36
  • Woot's massive PC sale kicks off with up to 75% off gaming desktops, monitors, coolers, and more, deals starting from $5
  • SSD enclosure with built-in display featuring power loss protection, today only $29
  • Razer portable 11-in-1 USB-C hub plummets to $52, historic low (57% off)
  • Twelve South USB-C wall charger with Find My hits new low on Amazon, priced below $37
  • ! These leather Apple Watch bands are just $6 with free shipping for Prime members (75% off)

Amazon now has AirPods Max 2 in all five colors at $120 off (one of the best prices ever)

This week's major 60th anniversary sale brings one of the best prices ever for Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now offering $120 off across all five colors.

Amazon is currently selling Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429, with free shipping.

Also priced at $549 (same as the previous generation), that's a solid $120 saved, and it's the best price we've found at reputable retailers for units sold in new condition.

Best Buy is indeed selling the midnight black 'Premium' open-box version for $403.99, with free shipping. While cheaper, it may not be enough to sway people away from a new unit.

Apple has released a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, rather than just adding new colors and a USB-C port to the previous version. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, the over-ear model won't be updated in next month's new product release, so this week's opportunity to grab what might be Apple's latest and greatest over-ear headphones at $120 off is worth considering.

Previously, only one promotional event offered a lower price — that was Prime Day earlier this summer, when the price was $30 lower than this deal. However, inventory was quite limited and inconsistent during that 4-day promotion.

Amazon's best quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models get $220 off (matching Prime Day deals)

While Apple's Certified Refurbished Store is my first choice for iPhone deals, Apple is currently not selling the latest iPhone 17 Pro models in its store, which appears to be waiting until the 18 series launches next month. Amazon's top-quality Premium Renewed models are now priced up to $220 lower than new device pricing, returning to Prime Day levels.

Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed models have always been the most cost-effective way to get an unlocked iPhone 17 Pro. Not only do you save hundreds of dollars, you also get a 1-year Amazon Renewed guarantee and 'greater than 90% original battery life' — Amazon's non-'Premium' Renewed and refurbished units only come with a 90-day warranty, and the battery life won't perform the same.

Right now, you can once again find 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models with up to $120 off — the 512GB version is $20 lower than when we last mentioned it:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)

According to yesterday's detailed feature on Apple's Refurbished Store picks, you can get a capable iPhone 16 with 1 year of Apple warranty starting from $699, as well as a 1TB 16 Pro Max for $1,269 — $330 lower than the equivalent 17 Pro Max, and $130 lower than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 starting from $699 (up to $330 less than the 17 series)
